title: carex cespitosa var. goodenowii
intro: Carex cespitosa var. goodenowii, commonly known as Good's sedge, is a type of grass-like perennial plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. Good's sedge is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, fever, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, relieving congestion, and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Carex cespitosa var. goodenowii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
